title: Evidence-grounded judgment authority
purpose: Require the project to make bounded, reversible decisions from the evidence it already possesses instead of treating an unspecified future reviewer as the source of judgment.

decision_ladder.label: observed
decision_ladder.meaning: A source-addressable observation or null is preserved without a mechanism judgment.

decision_ladder.label: candidate_judgment
decision_ladder.meaning: The evidence supports a bounded candidate or non-link decision but not the asserted mechanism.

decision_ladder.label: bounded_working_judgment
decision_ladder.meaning: The available receipts, counterevidence, and causal fields support a working judgment with named limits.

decision_ladder.label: provisional_public_judgment
decision_ladder.meaning: A bounded judgment may be communicated publicly with attached receipts, uncertainty, alternatives, and correction route.

decision_ladder.label: operational_decision
decision_ladder.meaning: The evidence is sufficient to choose and execute a reversible research, indexing, acquisition, or governance action.

decision_ladder.label: independently_corroborated
decision_ladder.meaning: A distinct reviewer or reproducer has added independent evidence or successfully attacked the decision.

blocker_law.rule: A blocked decision must name a material evidence, custody, selection, privacy, legal, reproducibility, or reversibility defect. Missing independent review may reduce confidence or withhold the word cleared, but it cannot be the sole reason to refuse a bounded judgment or reversible action.

selection_lane.rule: A valid lane receives an operational decision even while adversarial review is pending. Coverage gaps determine the next action; review absence does not produce wait.

k0_event.rule: Events meeting the threshold become bounded working judgments. Independent review may challenge or raise confidence; it does not create the project’s permission to judge.

report.decision_unit: one structured report or case projection
report.rule: Verified claim content may support a working report judgment while unresolved claims remain explicitly separated.

lake_basin.decision_unit: one semantic basin or gap queue
lake_basin.rule: The project ranks and executes bounded repair work from measured gap burden. No basin waits for an unspecified reviewer before reversible indexing, custody, or acquisition work proceeds.

confidence_law.independent_review_effect: Independent review is one confidence input. It can raise, lower, or overturn a judgment, but its absence does not set confidence to zero.

reversibility_law.default: Every generated judgment is append-preserving and replaceable by a later evidence-backed decision.
